newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ommeren buys terminals in Brazil, Chile.
newsitem.headline: Ommeren buys terminals in Brazil, Chile.

text.p: Shipping and tank storage firm Koninklijke van Ommeren NV said on Thursday it had agreed to buy chemicals storage terminals in Brazil and Chile from unlisted Dutch firm Holland Chemical International (HCI).

Van Ommeren said the acquisitions comprised chemicals terminals in Aratu and Santos in Brazil and San Antonio in Chile. Apart from chemicals the facilities are also used to store animal and vegetable oils and fats.
The acquisition of terminals in Latin America represented an important addition to Van Ommeren's international network of tank storage businesses, the company said in a statement.
The growth in privatisation of the chemical industry in Latin America offered opportunities for further expansion of the independent tank storage sector, it said.
